item.tib: zhang zhung snyan brgyud kyi bon skor bka' brgyud skor bzhi'i dpe rtsis mu tig phring ba
item.coloph: [. . .] nyag rong [. .] mchog sprul tshe dbang [. .] nas snyan rgyud bka' rgyud skor bzhi'i par bkod [. . .] dpe rtsis . dgos [.] gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas [. . . . . . . .] chab gcig tu shar rdza'i bya bral bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba dge'o / par bkod pa grub ngan mdzad byung 'di nyid nas [. . . . . .]
item.note: the colophon is partly illegible (illegible syllables are represented by periods in the transcription), but in line 3 we can at least read that this work was composed by shar-rdza due to a request by nyag-rong mchog-sprul tshe-dbang [last part of the name illegible].
